# D6 cockpit instruments - generation log

**Generated by `staging/phase_g/ship_d6.py` from the Phase G lane. Never hand-edit.**

Model: `gpt-image-2-5-flare-text-to-image` (`flare`), 2K, aspect 1:1, opaque render on a plain solid pure white background (UI_CHROME_ASSETS_SPEC section 1.2). Style law: `vajb-orbit/assets/style-block.txt` passed verbatim as the prompt preamble. Work order: UI_CHROME_ASSETS_SPEC section 11 (wave D6); per-run prompts are that section's verbatim text plus section 8's negative list.
Alpha: each panel object is cut out of the render on its own box, keyed on its own through `recraft/remove-background` (`staging/phase_g/key_new.py`), then trimmed and centred (`staging/phase_g/refit_panels.py`); a panel is never keyed whole. Masters ship at 2x their logical box (section 11's table).
Six files are not a plain cut because the render could not deliver them (three attempts each); the Route column names the step, and the D6-M0 report carries the measurements.
AI-generated art is not CC0 (AGENTS.md).
